basic_info.description: This Glen Park turnkey house has a beautiful updated kitchen, great flow and natural light, a big private backyard, and a spacious garage. It is detached on 3 sides and has nice curb appeal, charm, and character. There is a mudroom-like entry which leads into the living room. The living room features a handsome fireplace and is next to the kitchen. The bright kitchen is well-appointed and has outlooks of trees from the window above the sink and of the backyard. The dining area has a window that has a nice view of the backyard. 2 comfortable bedrooms and a bathroom complete this level. The rear bedroom looks out to the backyard as well. Hardwood floors and period details. Great layout for indoor and outdoor entertaining with direct access to the backyard from the kitchen. The inviting backyard offers multiple areas for entertaining, grilling, and lounging. It has gorgeous mature trees and peek-a-boo views across Glen Park. The spacious garage has high ceilings and ample storage space. Near multiple parks such as the beloved Glen Canyon Park and Glen Park Recreation Center as well as restaurants and shops on Diamond St. and Monterey Blvd. Easy access to BART and 280. Short drive to West Portal, Bernal Heights, and Noe Valley. This home has been cared for by the owner for decades.
